en: Black‑and‑white vertical postcard view of a quiet cobblestone street lined with stone townhouses and garden walls, leading toward a large Gothic‑style church with a very tall, slender spire. Trees frame the scene on both sides and a few people stand on the sidewalk and in the street. The architecture appears Central European, likely late 19th century. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
